name: dsh-guofeng-studio
description: Chinese-style songwriting studio for DeepSeek Harness: bundles the composer and lyricist skills plus a word-song orchestration skill, so one install gives the agent mode/scale decisions, numbered-notation melodies, chord charts, arrangement tables, rhyme/imagery/ allusion lint, .jp/.lyr/.slots.json handoff and multi-track MIDI export. All local, no network, no API keys.
